prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Your Companion is Arriving Soon!", "While your pet downloads, check out how to interact with them on your desktop.", "Drag to reposition | Right-click for menu | Ctrl+Shift+H to hide pet"]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls 101", "Learn the basic shortcuts to manage your pet on your desktop screen.", "I'm Ready!", "Right-click pet to chat or feed; Click & drag anywhere; Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H to hide/show."]
3: ["Review Pet Generation Preview", "Ensure lighting and framing look clear before generating your pet companion.", "Looks Good!", "Retake Photo"]
4: ["Downloading pet assets and preparing desktop rendering engine..."]
5: ["Sign In to Securely Save Your Pet", "Linking an account keeps your custom pets, unlocked items, and adoption certificates backed up safely in the cloud.", "Always use the same login method to access your pet across devices."]
6: ["Select Your Path & Claim an Exclusive Starter Hat", "Every journey choice unlocks a unique accessory for your pet companion.", "Bonus Unlocked: Starter Party Hat"]
7: ["For best generation, use bright lighting, clear focus, and direct face views.", "Avoid dark shadows, extreme angles, or heavy image blur."]
8: ["Choose Your Mascot Companion", "Explore default pets", "Play voice sample"]
9: ["Pet will sit in your desktop taskbar/system tray when minimized.", "Tray Access Active"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions exclusive bonuses and free extras.
